metadata.question: Was the mean aerosol optical depth higher over Chengdu than over Suining between 2001 and 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need AOD (Aerosol Optical Depth) data from 2001-2023 - Use MODIS (MOD04_L2 or similar) which has global AOD data - Two locations: Chengdu (104.07°E, 30.57°N) and Suining (105.59°E, 30.64°N) in Sichuan, China - Filter by date range 2001-2023 2. Masking strategy: - AOD data should already be quality-controlled in MODIS products - Need to select appropriate AOD band (typically 'Optical_Depth_Land_2') - No need for cloud masking as AOD data is derived from cloud-free pixels 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after filtering (C2) - Validate results are in reasonable range (0-3 for AOD) and not None (C3) - Compare mean AOD: Chengdu > Suining = A, else = B ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Define geometries chengdu = ee.Geometry.Point([104.07, 30.57]) suining = ee.Geometry.Point([105.59, 30.64]) # 2. Define time period start_date = '2001-01-01' end_date = '2023-12-31' # 3. Load MODIS AOD data (MOD04_L2 - Aqua, better temporal coverage) try: col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD04_L2') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .select('Optical_Depth_Land_2') size = col.size().getInfo() print(f"MODIS MYD04_L2 collection size: {size} images") if size == 0: # Fallback to Terra MODIS col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD04_L2') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .select('Optical_Depth_Land_2') size = col.size().getInfo() print(f"Switched to MOD04_L2, size: {size} images") if size == 0: print("No AOD data available for 2001-2023") print("C1") else: # 4. Calculate mean AOD for each location chengdu_mean = col.mean().sample(chengdu, scale=1000).first().get('Optical_Depth_Land_2').getInfo() suining_mean = col.mean().sample(suining, scale=1000).first().get('Optical_Depth_Land_2').getInfo() print(f"Chengdu mean AOD: {chengdu_mean}") print(f"Suining mean AOD: {suining_mean}") # 5. Validation if chengdu_mean is None or suining_mean is None: print("Missing data at one or both locations") print("C3") elif chengdu_mean < 0 or suining_mean < 0 or chengdu_mean > 3 or suining_mean > 3: print("AOD values out of valid range") print("C3") else: # Count valid pixels count_chengdu = col.mean().sample(chengdu, scale=1000).first().get('Optical_Depth_Land_2') print(f"Chengdu AOD (2001-2023): {chengdu_mean:.3f}") print(f"Suining AOD (2001-2023): {suining_mean:.3f}") print(f"Difference (Chengdu - Suining): {chengdu_mean - suining_mean:.3f}") if chengdu_mean > suining_mean: print("A") else: print("B") except Exception as e: print(f"Error: {str(e)}") print("D") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define geometries
chengdu = ee.Geometry.Point([104.07, 30.57])
suining = ee.Geometry.Point([105.59, 30.64])

# 2. Define time period
start_date = '2001-01-01'
end_date = '2023-12-31'

# 3. Load MODIS AOD data (MOD04_L2 - Aqua, better temporal coverage)
try:
    col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD04_L2') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .select('Optical_Depth_Land_2')
    
    size = col.size().getInfo()
    print(f"MODIS MYD04_L2 collection size: {size} images")
    
    if size == 0:
        # Fallback to Terra MODIS
        col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD04_L2') \
            .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
            .select('Optical_Depth_Land_2')
        size = col.size().getInfo()
        print(f"Switched to MOD04_L2, size: {size} images")
    
    if size == 0:
        print("No AOD data available for 2001-2023")
        print("C1")
    else:
        # 4. Calculate mean AOD for each location
        chengdu_mean = col.mean().sample(chengdu, scale=1000).first().get('Optical_Depth_Land_2').getInfo()
        suining_mean = col.mean().sample(suining, scale=1000).first().get('Optical_Depth_Land_2').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Chengdu mean AOD: {chengdu_mean}")
        print(f"Suining mean AOD: {suining_mean}")
        
        # 5. Validation
        if chengdu_mean is None or suining_mean is None:
            print("Missing data at one or both locations")
            print("C3")
        elif chengdu_mean < 0 or suining_mean < 0 or chengdu_mean > 3 or suining_mean > 3:
            print("AOD values out of valid range")
            print("C3")
        else:
            # Count valid pixels
            count_chengdu = col.mean().sample(chengdu, scale=1000).first().get('Optical_Depth_Land_2')
            print(f"Chengdu AOD (2001-2023): {chengdu_mean:.3f}")
            print(f"Suining AOD (2001-2023): {suining_mean:.3f}")
            print(f"Difference (Chengdu - Suining): {chengdu_mean - suining_mean:.3f}")
            
            if chengdu_mean > suining_mean:
                print("A")
            else:
                print("B")

except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {str(e)}")
    print("D")
